create_PetitNvFp4Config: create a PetitNvFp4Config from HF quantization config with NVFP4 checkpoint serialization
test_is_petit_nvfp4_compatible: test if a model quant method is compatible with Petit NVFP4 on HIP GPUs
build_PetitNvFp4LinearMethod: build a PetitNvFp4LinearMethod to create and manage NVFP4 quantized linear layer weights
apply_PetitNvFp4LinearMethod: apply NVFP4 quantized linear operation to input tensor with weight scales and optional bias
review_PetitNvFp4Config: review PetitNvFp4Config to verify group size, kv cache quant algo, and excluded modules are specified
